title: CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic. CHASE records herself throughout…
content:
CAMERA: Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic. CHASE records herself throughout every location, mostly holding the camera directly and occasionally setting it down for brief hands-free shots. Preserve natural hand tremors, crooked composition, slow autofocus correction, awkward zooms, accidental face cropping, and moments where the framing briefly loses her. The physical camcorder is never visible.

LOOK: Authentic soft tape-image texture with mild blur, subtle electronic grain, glowing highlights, small automatic-exposure fluctuations, restrained contrast, and natural skin tones. The lighting changes realistically between locations: warm morning light in the apartment → cooler daylight inside the car → intense colorful lighting backstage and onstage.

STYLE: A fast, energetic day-in-the-life montage with sharp cuts between locations and slightly accelerated transitional movement. Reflective voiceover plays over the footage instead of synchronized dialogue. The pace gradually builds from a quiet sleepy morning into a high-energy performance finale.

Character

CHASE — an exceptionally beautiful Instagram influencer and rising pop performer in her 20s. Long glossy dark-brown hair, striking symmetrical features, large expressive eyes, flawless glowing skin, and soft pink lips. Slim, toned figure. Her outfit changes with each location: cozy loungewear at home, stylish casual clothing during the ride, and a glamorous performance outfit for the final scene. Each outfit fully covers her arms and torso.

Setting Progression
Stylish apartment bedroom in the morning → luxury van interior during the day → busy backstage area and concert stage at night.

Storyboard — 15 seconds, 5 cuts
(~3s, bedroom, camera resting on a table, soft morning light) She slowly sits up, stretches, fixes her messy hair, and hurriedly packs a small bag. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “Some mornings begin before I’m even fully awake.”

(~3s, van interior, handheld selfie footage, natural window light) She sits beside the window as sunlight moves across her face, casually checking messages on her phone. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “I spend so much time on the road, this place almost feels like home.”

(~3s, van interior, macro detail shot) Close-up of her fingers choosing a song from a playlist while passing sunlight flickers across the screen and her hand. No voiceover, only natural road noise.

(~3s, backstage, fast handheld montage) Quick glimpses of makeup brushes, hair styling, costume adjustments, staff rushing past, and her taking one focused breath before going onstage. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “And then everything suddenly starts moving at once.”

(~3s, stage, wide shot moving into a close-up, energetic finale) Bright stage lights ignite as she steps through the curtains. The camera catches her silhouette, then a brief confident smile before the image cuts to black. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “This moment is why I keep doing it.”

es.content:
CAMERA: Estética de videocámara DV 16mm handheld. CHASE se graba a sí misma en cada ubicación, sosteniendo la cámara directamente la mayor parte del tiempo y, de vez en cuando, dejándola apoyada para breves tomas sin manos. Conserva los temblores naturales de la mano, la composición torcida, la corrección lenta del autofocus, los zooms torpes, los recortes accidentales del rostro y los momentos en que el encuadre la pierde brevemente. La videocámara física nunca es visible.

LOOK: Textura auténtica de imagen de cinta suave, con ligero desenfoque, grano electrónico sutil, brillos resplandecientes, pequeñas fluctuaciones automáticas de exposición, contraste contenido y tonos de piel naturales. La iluminación cambia de forma realista entre ubicaciones: luz cálida de la mañana en el apartamento → luz diurna más fría dentro del coche → iluminación intensa y colorida entre bastidores y en el escenario.

STYLE: Un montaje rápido y enérgico de un día en la vida, con cortes bruscos entre ubicaciones y movimiento transicional ligeramente acelerado. Una voz en off reflexiva acompaña las imágenes en lugar de diálogo sincronizado. El ritmo va creciendo gradualmente desde una mañana tranquila y somnolienta hasta un final de actuación de alta energía.

Character

CHASE — una influencer de Instagram excepcionalmente hermosa y una estrella emergente del pop en sus 20 años. Cabello largo, oscuro y brillante, rasgos simétricos impactantes, ojos grandes y expresivos, piel impecable y luminosa, y labios rosados suaves. Figura esbelta y tonificada. Su vestuario cambia con cada ubicación: ropa cómoda para estar en casa, ropa casual con estilo durante el trayecto y un atuendo glamuroso de actuación para la escena final. Cada conjunto cubre completamente sus brazos y torso.

Setting Progression
Dormitorio de un apartamento elegante por la mañana → interior de una furgoneta de lujo durante el día → zona de backstage concurrida y escenario de concierto por la noche.

Storyboard — 15 seconds, 5 cuts
(~3s, bedroom, camera resting on a table, soft morning light) Se incorpora lentamente, se estira, se arregla el cabello despeinado y mete a toda prisa una pequeña bolsa. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “Algunas mañanas empiezan antes de que yo esté completamente despierta.”

(~3s, van interior, handheld selfie footage, natural window light) Se sienta junto a la ventana mientras la luz del sol se mueve por su rostro, revisando mensajes en su teléfono con naturalidad. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “Paso tanto tiempo en la carretera que este lugar casi se siente como casa.”

(~3s, van interior, macro detail shot) Primer plano de sus dedos eligiendo una canción de una playlist mientras destellos de luz solar atraviesan la pantalla y su mano. Sin voz en off, solo el ruido natural de la carretera.

(~3s, backstage, fast handheld montage) Breves destellos de brochas de maquillaje, peinado, ajustes del vestuario, personal pasando a toda prisa y ella tomando una respiración concentrada antes de salir al escenario. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “Y entonces todo empieza a moverse de golpe.”

(~3s, stage, wide shot moving into a close-up, energetic finale) Las luces brillantes del escenario se encienden cuando ella atraviesa las cortinas. La cámara capta su silueta y luego una breve sonrisa segura antes de que la imagen se corte a negro. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “Este momento es la razón por la que sigo haciéndolo.”

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
How do you make AI videos look as realistic as possible with simple prompts?

It’s easier than it looks.

This video was made with Seedance 2.0. Here’s the exact prompt I used:

CAMERA:
Handheld DV 16mm camcorder aesthetic. First-person footage recorded entirely by CHASE while she holds the camera herself. Keep natural hand tremors, slightly crooked composition, slow autofocus correction, awkward zooms, accidental framing errors, and occasional selfie shots where part of her face slips out of frame. The camera sometimes briefly loses track of the subject. Every scene is filmed by CHASE in either selfie mode or direct POV. The physical camcorder is never visible.

LOOK:
Authentic DV 16mm home-video texture. Soft and mildly unfocused tape image, subtle electronic grain, gentle highlight blooming beneath the gym lights, minor automatic exposure shifts, restrained contrast, and natural-looking skin tones.

STYLE:
A lively but relaxed fitness-vlog atmosphere — cheerful between exercises, slightly out of breath, spontaneous laughter, and short motivational remarks. Fully handheld, fast edits, switching naturally between selfie footage, POV angles, and mirror shots.

CHARACTER:

CHASE — an exceptionally beautiful Instagram fitness influencer in her 20s. Long glossy dark-brown hair pulled into a high ponytail, striking symmetrical features, large expressive eyes, flawless glowing skin with a subtle post-workout sheen. Slim, toned athletic physique. She wears a fitted but modest long-sleeve workout top with high-waisted leggings or relaxed joggers, keeping her arms and torso fully covered, athletic sneakers, and a small towel draped around her neck. No jewelry.

SETTING:

A modern gym during the early evening — a large mirrored wall, dumbbell racks, an open stretching area, a water bottle resting on a nearby bench, several exercise machines in the background, and soft overhead illumination.

STORYBOARD:

(~2s, front-facing selfie, arm’s length)
She enters while filming herself, smiling brightly even though she is already slightly winded.
CHASE: “Hey everyone, I’m doing a quick workout vlog today!”
(~2s, loose handheld whip pan)
The camera swings from the dumbbell rack → mirrored wall → stretching zone, then snaps back toward her face.
CHASE (off-camera, amused): “It’s almost empty in here right now. Perfect.”

(~2s, medium handheld shot beside the mirror)
She watches her reflection while stretching and briefly tightens her ponytail.
CHASE: “I’m warming up first so I don’t regret this later.”
(~1.5s, close detail insert, shallow depth of field)
Tight shot of her fingers twisting open the cap of a cold water bottle, tiny droplets of condensation visible. No speech, only natural gym ambience.

(~2s, medium handheld tracking shot)
She performs a short set of controlled lunges or light squats, checking the lens between repetitions.
CHASE: “Only a few reps in and my legs are already complaining.”

(~2s, quick cut, seated on a bench)
She drops onto the bench, drinks some water, pats her forehead with the towel, and takes a deep breath.
CHASE: “Okay, emergency water break.”
(~1.5s, fast push-in, tight selfie framing)
Her cheeks are flushed and a few damp strands of hair cling near her face as she smiles into the lens.
CHASE: “This is the glamorous part Instagram usually leaves out.”
(~2s, arm’s-length selfie ending)
She gets back up with the towel resting over one shoulder, gives the camera a tired but satisfied wave and thumbs-up, then reaches forward to stop recording.
CHASE: “That’s it for today. See you next time!”

#AIVideo

fr.content:
CAMÉRA : esthétique de caméscope DV 16 mm tenu à la main. CHASE se filme elle-même dans chaque lieu, en tenant le plus souvent la caméra directement et en la posant parfois pour de brefs plans sans les mains. Préserver les tremblements naturels de la main, la composition de travers, la correction lente de l’autofocus, les zooms maladroits, les cadrages accidentels qui coupent le visage, et les moments où le cadrage la perd brièvement. Le caméscope physique n’est jamais visible.

LOOK : texture authentique d’image de bande douce avec léger flou, grain électronique subtil, hautes lumières qui brillent, petites fluctuations automatiques de l’exposition, contraste mesuré et tons de peau naturels. L’éclairage change de manière réaliste selon les lieux : lumière chaude du matin dans l’appartement → lumière du jour plus froide dans la voiture → éclairage intense et coloré en coulisses et sur scène.

STYLE : un montage rapide et énergique d’une journée dans la vie, avec des coupes nettes entre les lieux et des mouvements de transition légèrement accélérés. Une voix off réflexive accompagne les images au lieu de dialogues synchronisés. Le rythme monte progressivement d’un matin calme et somnolent vers un final de performance à haute énergie.

Character

CHASE — une influenceuse Instagram exceptionnellement belle et une pop performeuse montante dans la vingtaine. Longs cheveux brun foncé brillants, traits symétriques saisissants, grands yeux expressifs, peau impeccable et lumineuse, et lèvres rose tendre. Silhouette fine et tonique. Sa tenue change à chaque lieu : tenue d’intérieur confortable à la maison, vêtements décontractés et stylés pendant le trajet, puis tenue de scène glamour pour la scène finale. Chaque tenue couvre entièrement ses bras et son torse.

Setting Progression
Chambre d’appartement élégante le matin → intérieur d’un van de luxe en journée → coulisses animées et scène de concert la nuit.

Storyboard — 15 secondes, 5 coupes
(~3s, chambre, caméra posée sur une table, douce lumière du matin) Elle se redresse lentement, s’étire, remet ses cheveux en désordre en place et fait rapidement sa petite valise. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : “Certaines matinées commencent avant même que je sois complètement réveillée.”

(~3s, intérieur du van, selfie filmé à la main, lumière naturelle de la fenêtre) Elle est assise près de la fenêtre tandis que la lumière du soleil glisse sur son visage, en train de consulter distraitement ses messages sur son téléphone. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : “Je passe tellement de temps sur la route que cet endroit me semble presque être chez moi.”

(~3s, intérieur du van, plan macro détaillé) Gros plan sur ses doigts choisissant une chanson dans une playlist tandis que des éclats de soleil traversent l’écran et sa main. Pas de voix off, seulement le bruit naturel de la route.

(~3s, coulisses, montage rapide à la main) Brèves images de pinceaux de maquillage, coiffure, ajustements de costume, membres du staff qui passent en courant, et elle qui prend une respiration concentrée avant de monter sur scène. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : “Et puis tout se met soudain à bouger en même temps.”

(~3s, scène, plan large qui se rapproche en gros plan, final énergique) Les lumières vives de la scène s’allument lorsqu’elle franchit les rideaux. La caméra capte sa silhouette, puis un bref sourire confiant avant que l’image ne coupe au noir. VOIX OFF (CHASE) : “C’est pour ce moment-là que je continue.”

ko.content:
CAMERA: 핸드헬드 DV 16mm 캠코더 감성. CHASE가 카메라를 직접 들고 모든 장소를 스스로 촬영하며, 대부분은 카메라를 손에 쥔 채 기록하고 가끔은 잠깐 손을 놓고 촬영한다. 자연스러운 손떨림, 삐뚤어진 구도, 느린 오토포커스 보정, 어색한 줌, 실수로 얼굴이 잘리는 프레이밍, 그리고 잠시 그녀를 놓치는 순간들을 그대로 유지한다. 물리적인 캠코더는 절대 보이지 않는다.

LOOK: 진짜 같은 소프트 테이프 이미지 질감에 은은한 블러, 미세한 전자 노이즈, 빛나는 하이라이트, 작은 자동 노출 변화, 절제된 대비, 자연스러운 피부 톤을 유지한다. 조명은 장소에 따라 현실적으로 변한다: 아파트의 따뜻한 아침빛 → 차 안의 더 시원한 낮빛 → 백스테이지와 무대의 강렬하고 다채로운 조명.

STYLE: 장소를 빠르게 넘나드는, 에너지 넘치는 데이 인 더 라이프 몽타주로, 컷 전환은 날카롭고 전환 동작은 약간 가속된 느낌이다. 동기화된 대사 대신, 회상적인 보이스오버가 영상 위에 깔린다. 템포는 조용하고 졸린 아침에서 시작해, 고에너지 공연 피날레로 점차 고조된다.

Character

CHASE — 20대의, 놀라울 정도로 아름다운 인스타그램 인플루언서이자 떠오르는 팝 퍼포머. 길고 윤기 나는 짙은 갈색 머리, 눈에 띄는 대칭적인 이목구비, 크고 표현력 있는 눈, 결점 없이 빛나는 피부, 부드러운 분홍빛 입술. 슬림하고 탄탄한 체형. 의상은 장소마다 바뀐다: 집에서는 편안한 라운지웨어, 이동 중에는 스타일리시한 캐주얼 의상, 마지막 장면에서는 화려한 공연 의상. 각 의상은 팔과 상체를 완전히 가린다.

Setting Progression
아침의 세련된 아파트 침실 → 낮의 럭셔리 밴 내부 → 밤의 분주한 백스테이지와 콘서트 무대.

Storyboard — 15 seconds, 5 cuts
(~3s, bedroom, camera resting on a table, soft morning light) 그녀는 천천히 몸을 일으켜 스트레칭하고, 헝클어진 머리를 정리한 뒤, 작은 가방을 서둘러 챙긴다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “어떤 아침은 내가 완전히 깨어나기도 전에 시작돼.”

(~3s, van interior, handheld selfie footage, natural window light) 그녀는 창가 옆에 앉아 햇빛이 얼굴 위를 지나가는 동안 휴대폰으로 메시지를 가볍게 확인한다. VOICEOVER (CHASE): “나는 길 위에서 보내는 시간이 너무 많아서, 여기가 거의 집처럼 느껴져.”

(~3s, van interior, macro detail shot) 플레이리스트에서 노래를 고르는 그녀의 손가락 클로즈업. 스크린과 손 위로 지나가는 햇빛이 깜빡인다. 보이스오버 없이, 자연스러운 도로 소리만 들린다.

zh.content:
CAMERA：手持 DV 16mm 摄像机美学。CHASE 在每个地点都亲自拍摄自己，大多数时候直接手持相机，偶尔把相机放下，拍几段短暂的免手持镜头。保留自然的手部轻微抖动、歪斜构图、缓慢的自动对焦修正、笨拙的变焦、意外的脸部裁切，以及画面短暂丢失她身影的瞬间。物理摄像机本身绝不会出现在画面中。

LOOK：真实的柔和磁带影像质感，带轻微模糊、细微电子颗粒、发光高光、轻微的自动曝光波动、克制的对比度，以及自然的肤色。不同地点之间的光线变化要符合现实：公寓里温暖的晨光 → 车内更冷的日光 → 后台和舞台上强烈而多彩的灯光。

STYLE：节奏很快、充满活力的日常蒙太奇，不同地点之间用利落的剪切衔接，过渡动作略微加速。画面上方播放带反思意味的旁白，而不是同步对白。整体节奏从安静、昏昏欲睡的早晨，逐渐推进到高能量的演出收尾。

Character

CHASE——一位极其漂亮的 Instagram 网红，也是正在崛起的 20 多岁流行表演者。长而有光泽的深棕色头发，极具辨识度且对称的五官，大而有神的眼睛，完美发光的肌肤，以及柔和的粉色嘴唇。身材纤细、紧致。她的服装会随地点变化：家中穿舒适家居服，途中穿时髦休闲装，最终场景穿华丽的演出服。每套服装都必须完全遮住她的手臂和躯干。

Setting Progression
早晨的时尚公寓卧室 → 白天的豪华厢式车内部 → 夜晚繁忙的后台区域和演唱会舞台。

Storyboard — 15 seconds, 5 cuts
（约 3 秒，卧室，摄像机放在桌上，柔和晨光）她慢慢坐起，伸展身体，整理凌乱的头发，然后匆忙收拾一个小包。VOICEOVER（CHASE）：“有些早晨，在我还没完全清醒之前就已经开始了。”

（约 3 秒，厢式车内部，手持自拍画面，自然窗光）她坐在窗边，阳光掠过她的脸，她随意查看手机消息。VOICEOVER（CHASE）：“我有太多时间都在路上，这里几乎都快像家了。”

（约 3 秒，厢式车内部，微距细节镜头）特写她的手指在播放列表里选歌，阳光透过车窗在屏幕和她的手上忽明忽暗地闪动。无旁白，只有自然的路噪。

（约 3 秒，后台，快速手持蒙太奇）快速掠过化妆刷、发型整理、服装调整、工作人员匆匆走过，以及她在上台前深吸一口气。VOICEOVER（CHASE）：“然后一切突然就开始同时运转起来了。”

（约 3 秒，舞台，广角镜头推进到特写，充满能量的收尾）明亮的舞台灯光亮起，她穿过幕布走出。镜头捕捉到她的剪影，随后是一个短暂而自信的微笑，画面切黑。VOICEOVER（CHASE）：“这就是我一直坚持下去的原因。”
